content: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 13, 2026

title: Bitcoin hits 12-week low as dollar rallies on interest-rate outlook, liquidations top $1.6 billion
content: Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and is down 3.5% since midnight UTC, as the dollar climbs and liquidations top $1.6 billion.

title: Live news: Bitcoin briefly drops below 200-week moving average
content: Bitcoin fell below its 200-week moving average as the Dollar Index held above 103, while gold struggled to recover and oil prices rebounded.

title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
content: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
content: About 70% of the bitcoin treasury firm’s coins are pledged to the exchange, bought at roughly $118,000 each, and bitcoin now trades under $69,000.

title: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe
content: Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts.

title: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers
content: Unocoin said the transfers were signed and broadcast outside BitGo’s platform, and BitGo said the account freeze worked as intended.

title: Bitcoin returns to 200-week trend line as analyst sees risk of $57.7K next
content: Bitcoin price action interacted with its 200-week simple moving average for the first time since mid-August as it fell below $68,000.

title: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam
content: Authorities froze over $2.7 billion in Binance hack proceeds, while the separate FaceStealer scam stole over $400 million in 18 months.

title: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
content: Jane Street ended Q3 with 19% fewer shares in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, and a higher share price lifted the stake’s value to $957 million.

title: Nvidia Employees Push Board to Bring Back Jensen Huang: Report
content: An internal post urging Nvidia's board to weigh staff sentiment has drawn more than 1,600 comments, including calls to reinstate Huang.

title: Bitcoin Drops to $69K On 'Concentrated Liquidation' and 'Weakening' Demand
content: BTC dropped 5% on Friday, falling below $69,000. Experts say it was triggered by a "concentrated liquidation" and "weakening" demand.

title: Congress Summons Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Lutnick Over Chip Exports to China
content: House panels requested December interviews with Huang and Nvidia's top lawyer as scrutiny shifts to Commerce's oversight of chip exports.

title: Republican Senator Wants to Freeze AI Data Center Boom as Congress Pushes to Expand It
content: Senator Josh Hawley wants a nationwide construction pause until households are protected from rising power bills, even as Congress advances legislation designed to accelerate America's already massive AI infrastructure buildout.

title: North Korea Stole $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls, DOJ Says
content: The FBI says the “FaceStealer” scheme uses prerecorded footage and AI deepfakes of trusted contacts to trick crypto workers into installing malware on video calls—as the DOJ also moves to seize $1.2 billion from the Binance hack.

content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Trades Near $71,200 After a Fresh Session Low as the 10-Year Yield Holds Above 5% Bitcoin price traded near $71,200 Thursday evening after slipping to a fresh session low near $71,000, its weakest level since Aug. 20. title: Jane Street Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 54% to 4.1 Million Shares

title: DOJ’s Operation TorNado Arrests 354 and Seizes $234 Million in Cash and Crypto
content: Bitcoin Magazine DOJ’s Operation TorNado Arrests 354 and Seizes $234 Million in Cash and Crypto The Justice Department said the sweep that ran from May 2025 to October 2026 was the sixth and most extensive JCODE action since 2018, seizing 5.7 metric tons of drugs and 209 firearms, without saying how much of the money was cryptocurrency. This post DOJ’s Operation TorNado Arrests 354 and Seizes $234 Million in Cash and Crypto first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
